sections.title: 4. Hosting and server log files
sections.content:
This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. When you visit the website, the hosting provider automatically processes technical access data in so-called server log files: IP address, date and time of access, page accessed, browser type and version, and operating system.

This data is used exclusively for the secure, stable delivery of the website and error analysis; it is not merged with other data sources. The legal basis is Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure provision of our online offering). A data processing agreement is in place with Vercel; data is transferred to the USA on the basis of the EU Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: 5. Contact and request forms
sections.content:
If you use one of our request forms, we process the data provided there: phone number, email address, your chosen request, and the page from which the request was sent. This data is transmitted by email to info@k-aqua.de and, if a CRM system is connected, stored there to process your request.

For applications via the career form, the application data you provide (name, contact details, CV or details of experience and education) is transmitted by email to our HR department.

The purpose of the processing is exclusively to process your request or application. The legal basis is Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR (performance of pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR. The data will be deleted as soon as it is no longer required for the purpose and there are no conflicting statutory retention obligations.

To protect against automated spam submissions, we use an invisible technical check (honeypot field and time threshold), without third-party captcha services.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and consent
sections.content:
This website uses technically necessary cookies or comparable storage technologies, for example to store your language and display settings as well as your cookie decision. These are required for the operation of the website (legal basis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR or § 25 para. 2 TDDDG).

Via the cookie banner, you can additionally consent to the categories "Analytics" and "Marketing". We currently do not use any analytics or marketing services; should such services be integrated in the future, they will only be loaded after your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR, § 25 para. 1 TDDDG). You can revoke your consent at any time with effect for the future via the cookie settings.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content:
Within the framework of the applicable legal provisions, you have the right at any time to:

- Information about your stored personal data (Art. 15 GDPR)
- Correction of incorrect data (Art. 16 GDPR)
- Deletion (Art. 17 GDPR)
- Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
- Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
- Objection to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR)
- Revocation of consent given with effect for the future (Art. 7 para. 3 GDPR)

To do so, contact the responsible body mentioned above or our data protection officer. In addition, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority, for us: The Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (HBDI), Wiesbaden.

sections.title: 8. SSL or TLS encryption

extendedProductText.p1: Our high-quality K-Aqua systems offer maximum reliability and durability for demanding projects worldwide.
extendedProductText.p2: Thanks to advanced materials and precise manufacturing in Germany, we guarantee simple installation and lasting safety.
extendedProductText.p3: Trust in certified quality and sustainable solutions that meet the highest international standards and increase the efficiency of your project.

extendedMarketText.p1: K-Aqua's solutions are specifically designed to meet the demands of local and international markets.
extendedMarketText.p2: We support general contractors and planners on-site with technical expertise and reliable systems for every challenge.
extendedMarketText.p3: Through our global network, we ensure that you receive exactly the products optimally suited for your regional construction projects.
extendedMarketText.p4: The water management challenges of our time demand tailored, durable infrastructure solutions. K-Aqua is actively engaged in international markets to meet the growing need for hygienic and leak-free piping networks. Whether in arid regions where every drop must be protected by leak-proof welded joints, or in highly dense metropolises with complex fire protection and sound insulation requirements, our PP-R and PPRCT systems provide the necessary reliability.
extendedMarketText.p5: In doing so, we focus not only on pure product distribution but see ourselves as a strategic local partner. Through technical training, on-site supervision, and close cooperation with local authorities, we ensure that international standards (such as DVGW, WRAS, SASO) are not just met, but exceeded. Thus, we sustainably contribute to the modernization of global water infrastructure.

support.title: Technical Support
support.sub: Engineering consulting, application technology, and on-site support.
support.metaDesc: Technical support, consulting, and application engineering for K-Aqua piping systems.

seoText.p1: K-Aqua's technical support is the backbone of our global infrastructure projects. We know that when installing industrial piping systems and high-performance PP-R lines, every second counts. Our team of fluid dynamics and polymer systems experts is by the side of international general contractors, architects, and civil engineers every step of the way.
seoText.p2: From initial planning and isometric calculations to pressure loss design and on-site welding process monitoring, we guarantee flawless implementation. Our Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) systems require the highest level of craftsmanship. That's why our Academy offers continuous training, while support steps in for complex thermal expansions or specific flow pressure requirements.
seoText.p3: By using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and predictive maintenance algorithms, we minimize downtime to an absolute minimum. Whether it's cold water systems in desert regions, high-purity industrial plants, or heating networks in arctic zones, the K-Aqua support infrastructure ensures smooth operation and the uncompromising longevity of your investment.

items.title: Predictive System Monitoring
items.desc: Our algorithms continuously analyze anomalies in the infrastructure. Before a critical state is reached, our level-3 team intervenes. Zero tolerance for latency. Zero tolerance for failures. We act before the error occurs.

items.title: Military Response Times
items.desc: For us, an SLA is not a guideline, but a physical law. For critical incidents, we guarantee initial responses in the millisecond range and immediate escalation to dedicated senior engineers. No holding patterns, just immediate execution.

items.title: Architecture Audits
items.desc: Your systems are put to the test according to the strictest standards of German engineering. Scalability, redundancy, and reliability are verified through ruthless stress tests. Vulnerabilities are eliminated, not managed.

items.title: Direct Developer Access
items.desc: Forget conventional support. For complex system integrations, you communicate directly with our core developers. No first-level filter, just raw, unfiltered technical expertise for immediate problem solving at the source code level.

sticky.title: Sovereignty in Crisis
sticky.lead: How we maintain system integrity under extreme load conditions.

items.title: Anomaly Detection
items.text: Automated systems detect micro-deviations in the data stream long before a visible failure.

items.title: Diagnostic Triage
items.text: AI-supported log analysis isolates the error vector. Assignment to the exactly matching specialist cluster.

items.title: Intervention
items.text: Deployment of hotfixes or automatic rerouting of traffic to redundant high-availability nodes.

items.title: Root Cause Analysis
items.text: Forensic investigation of the incident. Modification of the core architecture for permanent prevention.

items.title: Post-Mortem Protocol
items.text: Detailed technical report with cryptographic signature for absolute transparency and audit security.

timeline.title: The Emergency: Chronicle of an Intervention
timeline.desc: Every second counts. Our standardized procedure in the event of a critical system anomaly. Coldly calculated. Mercilessly executed.

hero.desc: From pipe sizing to commissioning: Our technical support accompanies planners and installers through every phase of a PP-R project, with a direct line to the engineers who developed the system. Support that thinks ahead, from planning to commissioning.

intro.title1: Support is not a call centre.
intro.p1: We do not consider technical support to be a downstream service, but an integral part of every project. If a weld seam is unclear on the construction site or a pressure test does not turn out as expected, every hour counts.
intro.p2: Our engineers know every batch, every standard, and every processing regulation of our systems firsthand. They check isometrics, recalculate pressure losses, and stand right by the pipe during commissioning.
intro.p3: This is the claim of German engineering, applied to real construction sites, not to server racks.

bento.title: Support throughout the entire project
bento.lead: From initial planning to ongoing maintenance, our team accompanies your PP-R system through every phase.

items.title: Hydraulic Design & Isometrics
items.desc: We check your planning documents, recalculate pressure losses and dimensioning, and provide a reliable material list before construction begins.

items.title: Welding Technology Support
items.desc: Our technicians accompany the socket and electrofusion welding on site, check process parameters, and train your assembly team directly on the construction site upon request.

items.title: Pressure Testing & Acceptance
items.desc: We support the execution and documentation of the pressure test according to DIN 1988 and provide the test protocols required for building acceptance.

items.title: Spare Parts & Accessories Service
items.desc: Fast delivery of fittings, valves, and original accessories, even for existing systems and older K-Aqua batches.

items.title: Remote Diagnosis & On-Site Deployment
items.desc: For unresolved questions about processing or unclear test results, our technical support will call you back at short notice, if necessary with the deployment of a supervisor on site.

metrics.p1: We work according to the principles of German engineering: What we deliver must hold up under all construction site conditions.
metrics.p2: Every K-Aqua system is certified according to DVGW, SKZ, and KIWA. Every batch is traceable, every weld seam can be documented.
